title: S3-supplied model imported without integrity check
notes: Accepted per Article V. S3 path: joint_schema_model.py imported as executable Python without hash check. SECURITY.md documents required IAM/ACL controls.

title: S3 URI accepted from env with no bucket allowlist
notes: Accepted per Article V. SECURITY.md documents operator IAM responsibility.

title: server.log captures all server output — prospective state-echo risk
notes: Current code does not log state. Prospective: a future debug log addition could persist sensitive content. D-004 (rotation) now fixed.

title: PID reuse TOCTOU between _is_ember_server and os.kill
notes: OS-level TOCTOU; cannot be fully closed in userspace. _is_ember_server + /health cross-check are strong compensating controls. Documented in SECURITY.md.

title: Pidfile has no cryptographic integrity check
notes: Plain text pidfile; _is_ember_server + /health cross-check are strong compensating controls. Documented in SECURITY.md.

title: /health discloses auth_required and version
notes: auth_required is intentional for client compatibility. Version disclosure is a minor fingerprinting risk. Documented in SECURITY.md.

title: /metrics exposes model name device dtype
notes: Intentional design; same loopback boundary as inference. Documented in SECURITY.md.

title: No structured access log on health/metrics endpoints
notes: Acceptable for single-user loopback deployment. Documented in SECURITY.md.

title: Arbitrary code execution via model-dir import
notes: Wontfix: constitution Article V v3.0.0. OS-level isolation is the operator's responsibility.

title: Executable Python imported from model-controlled directory
notes: Wontfix: constitution Article V v3.0.0. Same root as E-001.

title: Model identity unverifiable — no weight hash check
notes: Wontfix: constitution Article V v3.0.0 removed mandatory hash verification.

title: Model dir in sys.path leaked full path in tracebacks
notes: joint_module() removes model_dir from sys.path in a finally block after import. Tests: test_joint_module_removes_model_dir_from_sys_path_after_import.

title: MCP logs had no timestamp — not correlatable with server events
notes: Named logger with %(asctime)s formatter in mcp_server.py. Tests: test_mcp_log_format_includes_timestamp.

title: model rm not logged — no audit trail for destructive ops
notes: _log.info('model remove: ...') in models.remove() for all paths. Tests: test_remove_logs_deletion_to_stderr.

title: /health disclosed model_dir filesystem path
notes: Removed model_dir from Engine.describe(). Tests: test_engine_describe_omits_model_dir.

title: ToolError forwarded raw server error bodies with paths/traces
notes: _sanitize_error(): 5xx generic message + stderr-only body; 4xx extracts FastAPI detail field only. Tests: test_server_4xx_error_body_is_sanitized.

title: Non-loopback host binding without bearer auth
notes: Regression — mitigation removed 2026-10-10: the fail-fast RuntimeError broke the documented Outerbounds deployment (EMBER_HOST=0.0.0.0, no EMBER_SERVER_AUTH_TOKEN, access control delegated to auth.type: API). Access control for a non-loopback deployment is now the operator's responsibility (platform gateway, reverse proxy, or EMBER_SERVER_AUTH_TOKEN). SECURITY.md documents this. Tests: test_lifespan_allows_non_loopback_host_without_auth.

title: advise calls not logged with question IDs or model label
notes: log.info('advise: questions=... model=...') after each successful call. Tests: test_advise_logs_question_ids_on_success.

title: server.log subprocess output cannot be rotated in-process
notes: RotatingFileHandler only rotates via emit() which the child subprocess never calls through the parent handler. Subprocess log rotation must be handled externally (logrotate). spawn() reverted to open('ab').

title: Concurrent autostart calls raced to spawn two servers
notes: fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX) around check-then-spawn in process.start(); re-checks is_up() after acquiring lock. Tests: test_start_acquires_file_lock_before_spawning.

title: S3 model download had no size cap
notes: max_bytes param in s3.download_prefix() with two-pass preflight + EMBER_S3_MAX_BYTES config key (default 100 GB). Tests: test_download_prefix_raises_when_total_size_exceeds_max_bytes.

flow_component: Z2→Z3: media decode before the size check
title: Oversized media decoded in full before refusal
notes: Counting media needs decoded images; media.py allows 32 images and 64 frames of up to ~179M px each (~512 MiB RGB). Needs an aggregate pre-decode pixel budget read from image headers. media_kwargs are validated before decoding.

title: No advisory for non-loopback + insecure transport
notes: log.warning() in mcp_server.main() for non-loopback + http + allow_insecure_transport. Tests: test_main_logs_warning_when_server_url_is_non_loopback_and_insecure.

title: uvicorn had no concurrency limit
notes: limit_concurrency=16 added to uvicorn.run() in server.py.

title: No rate limiting on inference endpoint
notes: AdmissionError semaphore (MAX_PENDING_ADVISE=4); HTTP 503.

title: Default 262144-token context exhausted MPS memory
notes: Full encoded request (state, media, questions, schema, prompt wrapper) counted with upstream encode_record in ember/serving/request_size.py; enforced in ember/serving/runtime.py with limits from ember/serving/limits.py (per-request cap: the model's measured default, 32768 until measured; 0 disables it); RequestTooLargeError → HTTP 413 with the token split.

title: EMBER_MCP resolved to arbitrary executable
notes: opencode-plugin/index.js: basename + existsSync validation.

title: stop() had no audit log
notes: _append_audit_log() before SIGTERM and SIGKILL in process.stop().

title: MCP trusted arbitrary server URL
notes: Endpoint.resolve() raises InsecureEndpointError for plaintext HTTP to non-loopback.

title: EMBER_MODEL_DIR accepted without directory validation
notes: is_dir() check only; superseded by constitution Article V v3.0.0. Fixed per PR #57.

title: Unreserved media_kwargs forwarded to joint_schema_model
notes: ALLOWED_MEDIA_KWARGS allowlist; disallowed keys → ValueError → HTTP 422.
